objective: retornatus init --preset writes a packaged TOML preset into config.toml, and verify enforces ship and AI surface rules only when changed or scoped paths match.
success_conditions: pytest exits 0 for the preset and surface tests
ruff check of src tests and scripts exits 0
mypy on the retornatus package exits 0
An unknown preset name exits with the available preset list
init without a preset preserves the gitignore block
python-platform preset extends the python checks
CHANGELOG Unreleased section records config presets
verify reports surface status not required when no infra or AI paths match
